title: Guardana Pack Lock v3
description: guardana-lock.yaml: every installed extension pinned by what it is, written by `guardana pack lock` and compared by `guardana pack lock --check`. Version 3 adds `renderers` and `reporters` to every pack and is written only when a pack pins an output or an output is unlocked; otherwise the lock is written as version 2. This build reads versions 1 and 2 too.

extension_api.description: The extension contract the lock was taken against; a lock taken under another one is not compared.

unlocked.description: Every id registered by no pack that declares a manifest; an output is spelled renderer:<name> or reporter:<name>.

rules.description: Each rule the pack declares, pinned by the digest of its declaration.

renderers.description: Each installed format the pack declares, pinned by name; the distribution version is the coarse pin.

reporters.description: Each installed reporter the pack declares, pinned by name; the distribution version is the coarse pin.

taxonomies.description: Each catalogue the pack declares, pinned by a digest over the references it registers.
